title: What does this return?
examObjective: Predicting the result of core DataWeave functions
basics: Many languages store decimals as binary fractions, so 0.1 + 0.2 comes out as 0.30000000000000004. DataWeave stores decimal numbers exactly, so sums of prices behave the way they do on paper.
prompt: Read the script. **What does it return?**

explanation.approach: Both results are exact. The practical consequence: rounding to hide binary-fraction errors is not needed here, and adding it can introduce errors of its own.
